study: Aung, T., Hill, A.K., Hlay, J.K., Hess, C., et al. (2024). Effects of Voice Pitch on Social Perceptions Vary With Relational Mobility and Homicide Rate. Psychological Science, 35(3), 250-262. DOI: 10.1177/09567976231222288
key_findings: Obtained authors' full replication package from OSF project tnygr (raw data iPodStudyData.csv, countrydata.csv, analysis code PsychSci.R, 60+ fitted model outputs as .rda, distance matrices, preregistration).

Headline moderation claims (voice-pitch x relational-mobility on male formidability/prestige and female flirtatiousness perceptions) reproduced in direction and magnitude via independent frequentist logistic mixed models (lme4): Formidability x RM est=0.393 [0.074,0.713], Prestige x RM est=0.321 [0.099,0.543], Flirtatiousness x RM est=0.470 [0.271,0.668].

My independent coefficients match the human FLoRA (Replication Games) frequentist robustness values almost exactly (0.394, 0.321, 0.470), and agree with the paper-implied odds ratios (e.g. Formidability x RM OR~1.57 reported as b, actually an OR).
Reported 'b' coefficients in the published text are frequently odds ratios, not log-odds (labeling error), confirmed by exponentiating fitted coefficients.

The authors' provided .rda model objects could not be loaded in the installed R 4.6.1 (serialization/version incompatibility), so exact Bayesian point estimates/CrI were not independently re-derived; frequentist replication used instead, consistent with the human robustness check.
Code defect confirmed: PsychSci.R uses object 'newdata' in the m1 brm() call but only 'data' is defined (fixable). Minor CrI mismatches beyond rounding also flagged by human reviewers.
Verdict matches the human FLoRA 'computational issues' classification: main findings computationally reproducible, with minor code/labeling issues that do not overturn conclusions.
notes: Graded CONSISTENT because headline numerical claims (moderating role of relational mobility on voice-pitch social perceptions) were independently re-computed and reproduce in direction and magnitude, matching the human robustness analysis. Not FULL because exact Bayesian point estimates were not re-derived (package/environment limits, unloadable author .rda objects). Not FAIL/PARTIAL since no headline claim was contradicted. Human FLoRA Replication Games report also concluded the main findings were reproduced (flora=computational issues, minor).
